title: Formal register speaking
description: Practise formal requests and academic-style claims.

items.targetText: I should be grateful if you could confirm the revised schedule.
The analysis of the findings suggests a substantial improvement.

items.prompt: Rewrite a casual request formally and add one tentative academic claim.
items.promptIt: Riscrivi una richiesta informale in formale e aggiungi un'affermazione accademica cauta.
items.exampleAnswer: I should be grateful if you could review the draft. The analysis of the findings suggests a substantial improvement, although further data would be useful.
